svg.title: Maximum arrival-charge forecast error across ten geographic journeys

cc:Work.dc:title: Maximum arrival-charge forecast error across ten geographic journeys
cc:Work.dc:description: Final 70-forecast regression batch against SUMO battery readings. Each bar is the largest absolute arrival-charge error for one journey, in percentage points. Values range from 0.010 to 0.471. This figure restates the published summary; it is not a new evaluation.
